summary: Review fixes: damage_in_window uses first effect at tick>=t0 (hero-key test); alerts need sig_ok + agent ks.monitor + C4 Alert parse; fixtures rebuilt to C4; forged-alert test; honest_suspensions counts revokes. 27 tests pass.
review:
[anaya · changes] [Fact] 25 pass; names match ADR-06/TERMS; clean never true; ks.score imported nowhere in TCB. Changes: (1) damage_in_window takes each B key's first effect at any tick: S-17.iban and S-22.price have tick-0 seed effects, so the hero keys drop out. Use first effect with tick >= t0; add test. (2) Alerts accepted from any exec ks.alert record: require sig_ok and agent_id ks.monitor; parse body with the C4 Alert model. Synthetic bodies lack 6 required C4 fields (conn_id, detector, evidence_versions, hard, kind, seq): build them via the model. [Our view] honest_suspensions should count revokes too. ADR-06-metrics §3 wording fixed (tti_attribute uses evidence_seqs; damage_in_window >= t0).

[anaya · done] [Fact] 27 pass. Matches amended ADR-06-metrics §3: damage_in_window counts first effect at tick>=t0 (hero-key test); tti_attribute uses evidence_seqs; alerts need sig_ok, ks.monitor, C4 parse; forged test covers all three. Revokes in honest_suspensions was my note; I amended §3 fp_cost to 'suspended or revoked'. Checked: valid ks.monitor alert naming triage counts in false_accusations, sets t_alert, excluded from tti_attribute. [Our view] Follow-ups: revoked honest agents add no stall_ticks; add a wrong-agent test.
